name: release-checklist-ordered-list-restarts-after-note
description: An ordered list is interrupted by a normal paragraph note, then resumes with numbering restarted at 1, which can be misread as a continuation in Markdown conversion.

runs.text: Confirm the build passed smoke tests in staging.
Tag the release candidate in Git.
Note: If legal has not approved the updated privacy wording, pause the rollout and notify support.
Archive the signed release notes PDF.
